title: Synthesis Advisor Response v1.0.0
description: Structured decision context for a synthesis finding. Five required sections, no recommendations.

whats_happening.description: Why this decision exists and why the pipeline is blocked or uncertain.

what_the_plan_says.description: Relevant binder excerpts or summaries grounding the decision.

whats_missing.description: The exact gap preventing execution or clarity.

options_and_tradeoffs.description: 2-4 realistic approaches with pros and cons.

impact.description: What changes depending on the choice — unblocked items, scope effects, DoD changes.
